tasks.title: Close OpenAI null/undefined TS2322/TS2345 errors across kloel-reply-engine + kloel-thinker
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never git restore.

MISSION: A linter/migration changed an OpenAI client provider from returning `OpenAI` to `OpenAI | null`, but call sites still expect `OpenAI` or `OpenAI | undefined`. Result: 8+ tsc errors. Close them with proper null narrowing and signature alignment.

FILES TO READ AND FIX (specific lines from `cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -E 'TS2322|TS2345' | grep -E 'OpenAI'`):
- backend/src/kloel/kloel-reply-engine.service.ts (line ~318)
- backend/src/kloel/kloel-thinker-think.helpers.ts (lines ~99, 105, 166, 172, 211)
- backend/src/kloel/kloel-thinker.helpers.ts (lines ~125, 131, 348)
- backend/src/kloel/kloel-thinker.service.ts (line ~248)

FOR EACH ERROR:
1. If the function parameter type is `OpenAI` (no nullable), but the caller passes `OpenAI | null`: add explicit guard `if (!openai) throw new Error('openai_client_unavailable')` before the call OR coerce `openai!` only when call sites have already guarded.
2. If the function parameter type is `OpenAI | undefined` but the caller passes `OpenAI | null`: prefer to narrow upstream by `?? undefined` (i.e., `openai ?? undefined`). The receiving function expects `undefined` not `null`.
3. Prefer real null-checks over `!` non-null assertions whenever the call path can be reached with null.
4. NEVER use `as any` or @ts-ignore.

DO NOT EDIT:
- scripts/pulse/*
- The OpenAI client provider/factory itself if the nullable return is intentional (read it first to confirm intent).
- StructuredLogger.

VALIDATION:
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -E 'OpenAI' | wc -l   # target: 0
  cd backend && npx jest --testPathPatterns='kloel-thinker|kloel-reply-engine' --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -10

COMMIT:
- fix(kloel): narrow OpenAI null/undefined at thinker + reply-engine call sites

FINAL REPORT: each fix applied (file:line, before/after), spec count.
